diagnosis: The patient clinical notes endpoint bypasses Sequelize model defaultScope restrictions by using sequelize.query with raw SQL. The query filters solely by patient_id, completely omitting the clinic_id check that prevents cross-clinic access. Medical staff from one clinic can view confidential psychiatric and diagnostic notes of patients registered at entirely separate clinics.
